ns2:group.ns2:description: What are the most successful companies doing differently with AI? At OpenAI France, Emmanuel Marill, Managing Director, EMEA at OpenAI, shares why the biggest opportunities come from thinking AI-first rather than adding AI to existing ways of working. He also reflects on focus, solving real business problems and why France has one of the world's strongest AI ecosystems.
